194877.overview:
Enter a dreamy world of butterflies and wonder! Farfalla's enchanted field is a unique fusion of elegance, fantasy and fast gameplay.

Farfalla (Italian for "butterfly") was released in 1983 by Zaccaria, and is widely regarded as one of the company's most iconic and visually striking solid-state pinball machines. Two versions of the backglass exist; an original "uncensored" version and a modified version for the US market that added clothing to the central female figure to meet more conservative standards.

In this game, players are challenged to find love (and a high score) in a colorful flower garden filled with butterflies. Knock down the orange, blue, and red butterfly drop targets to collect the corresponding colored flower specials, then lower the ramp and shoot for the upper playfield for a chance at the yellow butterflies there. Find love to increase the bonus multiplier, test your reflexes with the React Feature to prevent draining the ball, then advance the colored flower specials to unleash the Multi Special — all while the butterfly nymph on the backbox smiles and watches.

208980.overview: Fallout is one of the three pinball tables in the Bethesda Pinball mini table pack, released in 2016 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. It is heavily based on the 2015 post-apocalyptic RPG Fallout 4, while incorporating elements from previous games in the Fallout series. This table chronicles the journey of a Sole Survivor, resident of Vault 111 in the Commonwealth, as they travel across a wasteland many years after a nuclear war, searching for bobbleheads to improve combat and survival skills.

208988.overview: Fantastic Four is a Marvel pinball table released in 2011 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3 as one of three tables in the Marvel Legends pack. It is based on the eponymous superhero team, comprising of Mr. Fantastic (Reed Richards), The Thing (Ben Grimm), The Invisible Woman (Susan Storm) and The Human Torch (Johnny Storm), as well as their efforts to protect Earth from different villains.

208990.overview: Fear Itself is one of the four Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Avengers Chronicles Pack, released in 2012 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the 2011 comic miniseries of the same title, this table explores the Avengers' conflict with Cul Borson, otherwise known as the Serpent, an Asgardian deity of fear who unleashes fear across the world with the aid of several transformed and brainwashed superheroes.

460221.overview: An unlicensed Star Wars themed solid-state pinball machine released by LTD Do Brasil. The playfield layout is nearly identical to that of Gottlieb's 1978 'Close Encounters of the Third Kind'.

460232.overview: Fire Action De Luxe is a solid-state pinball machine released in 1983 by Taito do Brasil, a subsidiary of the Japanese company Taito. It is an enhanced version of the original Fire Action released by the same company in 1980.

460239.overview:
Fire Action is a pinball machine released in June 1980 by Taito do Brasil, a Brazilian division of the Japanese company Taito. 

It is most notable for being a clone or imitation of the legendary Williams Firepower pinball machine, which was also released in 1980. While the gameplay and layout are nearly identical to Firepower, Taito designed their own unique graphics for the playfield and backglass. 

A revised version titled Fire Action De Luxe was later released by Taito in 1983.

461904.overview:
Football is a rare, solid-state pinball machine released in 1979 by Taito of Brazil (Taito do Brasil), a prominent São Paulo-based subsidiary of the Japanese gaming giant Taito. It is heavily based on Williams' 1978 machine "World Cup".

Due to the table's rarity and the lack of surviving machines, the ROM is considered undumped or "lost". Despite the lack of a preserved original ROM, pinball preservationists and virtual pinball hobbyists have reverse-engineered and recreated the machine for Visual Pinball.

468503.overview:
Family Guy is one of four tables in the Balls of Glory table pack, based on animated Fox TV sitcoms. Released in the fall of 2015 as DLC, and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3, this table follows select events from the long-running animated sitcom about the complex and often dysfunctional life of the Griffin family, Quahog’s most notable residents.

This is the second pinball adaptation of the television series, with the first one being a physical table designed by Stern in 2007 designed by Pat Lawlor, a famous Williams pinball table designer.

469303.overview:
Butterfly dreams come alive! Brilliant hues, smooth gameplay, and glowing lights create a mesmerizing world where love blossoms with every spin.

Farfalla Deluxe is a digital reimagining of the classic 1983 Zaccaria pinball table, developed by Magic Pixel for the Zaccaria Pinball platform. 

Released on 21 April 2021, this "Deluxe" version transforms the original butterfly-themed solid-state machine into a contemporary digital experience featuring enhanced graphics, 3D models, and advanced gameplay mechanics.

It preserves the core identity of the original Farfalla—Italian for "butterfly"—while introducing modern digital enhancements.

469393.overview:
Venture into the volcano! Dodge lava flows and erupting targets in this molten, high-risk pinball expedition.

Released by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1980, Fire Mountain is a classic solid-state pinball machine known for its volcano-themed art and difficulty, due to the wide gap between flippers and the speed of the ball.

Hitting the targets to the left or the right lights the letters of the word "ERUPTION". When all letters of the word are completely lit, the SPECIAL will light which can be collected by hitting the central dropping target.

470174.overview:
After forming as a British blues band in the late ’60s, Fleetwood Mac evolved into one of the most influential rock groups of the ’70s. Not only did they write some of the decade’s most indelible songs—and release one of the best-selling albums of all time, 1977’s Rumours—but the troupe created a distinctive “California sound” that endures today as a sonic touchstone for countless bands.

This is a homebrew digital table created by Zandy's Arcade for Visual Pinball X. It is a mod of Bally's 1979 table, "Dolly Parton", and features 38 of Fleetwood Mac's biggest hits, including "Dreams", "Everywhere", and "Little Lies".

470426.overview:
Volcanic fury erupts again! Enhanced lava flows and molten jackpots make this table a blazing hot challenge.

Fire Mountain 2019 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1980 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2019 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470429.overview:
The future is now and shining bright! With dazzling neon accents and futuristic effects, this table transports you to a world of high-tech thrills and endless excitement.

Future World Deluxe is a bold reimagining of Zaccaria's classic 1978 Future World pinball table, delivering the thrill of space exploration to a new generation. Blast off on an interstellar adventure across five thrilling modes: Solar, Milky Way, Planet, Universe and Black Hole, each offering a unique cosmic challenge.

Face six celestial mini-games inspired by the wonders of our solar system, including Mercury, Mars, Sun, Jupiter, Saturn and Venus. With a playfield adorned in themes like orb, galaxy, black hole, and cosmic dust, every flip draws you deeper into the mysteries of the universe.

470430.overview:
The butterfly flies again! A refreshed fantasy garden with more sparkle, smoother flow, and richer color.

Farfalla 2017 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1983 solid-state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2017 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470964.overview: This is a re-theme of Williams' Flash (1979) for Visual Pinball X based around the DC Comics superhero.

471579.overview:
An enhanced version of Williams' 1987 table "F-14 Tomcat" for Future Pinball.

Built upon SLAMT1LT's F-14 Tomcat: Ultimate Pro Edition v1.01, TerryRed has updated the table with his AFTERBURNER and PinEvent V2 mod to provide the definitive digital version of this table.

471839.overview:
Bally's 1981 table was originally recreated for Future Pinball by Sza. This remastered version by SLAMT1LT improves upon the table physics, artwork, lighting and sounds. 

The ULTIMATE Pro Edition also includes music and video clips from the 1980 Flash Gordon movie, and the option (activated by holding down both flippers) to switch from modern to classic mode at any time. Switching doesn't just change the audio, it also changes the table rules: for example, modern rules include a multi-ball feature that wasn't available for the original table.

471940.overview:
Friday the 13th is an original pinball table by JP Salas for Visual Pinball X. Despite the title, it is not based on any specific movie, rather it is a horror themed table influenced by a number of different movies. The layout for the table is actually based on Stern's Godziila Pro machine.

You are Jason Voorhees and you return to Crystal Lake together with your friends Freddy and Michael, and you find a new teenager camp with teenagers all around the lake and your cabin occupied by the camp counselors. Inside your head you hear your mother's voice, urging you to kill them all. And as a good son, you listen to your mother.

472189.overview:
Flame of Athens is a cocktail pinball machine with a greek mythology theme from 1978, manufactured by Allied Leisure Industries, Inc.

The following year, Fascination International released a table identical to this one, using Allied's design and parts, called "Eros One".

472347.overview:
Father Ted is a sitcom created by Irish writers Graham Linehan and Arthur Mathews and produced by British production company Hat Trick Productions for British television channel Channel 4. It aired over three series from 21 April 1995 until 1 May 1998, including a Christmas special, for a total of 25 episodes.

Set on the fictional Craggy Island, a remote location off Ireland's west coast, Father Ted stars Dermot Morgan as Father Ted Crilly, alongside fellow priests Father Dougal McGuire (Ardal O'Hanlon) and Father Jack Hackett (Frank Kelly). Dishonourably exiled on the island by Bishop Leonard Brennan (Jim Norton) for various reasons, the priests live together in the parochial house with their housekeeper Mrs Doyle (Pauline McLynn). The show subverts parodies of low-brow humour as it portrays nuanced themes of loneliness, agnosticism, existentialism and purgatory experienced by its title character; this deeper meaning of the show has been much acclaimed.

Father Ted won several British Academy Television Awards—including twice for Best Comedy Series, and remains a popular sitcom in Ireland and the UK. In a 2001 Channel 4 poll, Dougal was ranked fifth on their list of the 100 Greatest TV Characters. In 2019, Father Ted was named the second-greatest British sitcom (after Fawlty Towers) by a panel of comedy experts for Radio Times.

This original table for Visual Pinball X was created by user BurgerEater289 and is a mod of Taito Do Brasil's 1982 table, Speed Test.

472368.overview:
The Fifth Element is an original table by ROM for Future Pinball, based on the 1997 science fiction movie starring Bruce Willis. Instead of a silver ball, the table incorporates an aspect of the film by using coloured "stones" or "elements" in the gameplay.

An updated version of the table was released in 2025 by RLR, adding a multiplayer mode and FizX3.3 physics.

474112.overview: Flight 2000: ULTIMATE Edition is an enhanced recreation of Stern's 1980 table for Future Pinball. Flight 2000 was one of the first pinball machines to include synthesized speech, and this ULTIMATE Edition adds music to the classic gameplay. A subsequent update to SLAMT1LT's ULTIMATE Edition by NitroNimbus upgrades the physics, the DMD, and adds Elton John's "Rocket Man" to the attract mode.

474113.overview:
SLAMT1LT's upgrade of Gottlieb's popular 1975 table adds Western-themed music and sound effects to the classic electro-mechanical gameplay. 

A later update by NitroNimbus upgrades the lighting and physics to further refine the experience.

479142.overview:
This Future Pinball recreation of the classic 1980 Williams table adds a fast-paced soundtrack and tweaks the multiball so that any balls lost in the first 30 seconds are returned into play.

A later NitroNimbus mod of this table updates the physics, improves the lighting and adds a DMD.

479821.overview: Gottlieb's Nightmare on Elm Street pinball machine from 1994 receives a significant graphical makeover for Visual Pinball X. Siggi has given this somewhat divisive table much-needed new playfield artwork, a new apron, and new plastics, so it looks better than ever before, even if the gameplay still isn't quite as good as it could be.

481060.overview:
The Foo Fighters are an American rock band formed in Seattle in 1994. Initially founded as a one-man project by former Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl, the band comprises vocalist/guitarist Grohl, bassist Nate Mendel, guitarists Pat Smear and Chris Shiflett, keyboardist Rami Jaffee and drummer Ilan Rubin.

The Foo Fighters have won 15 Grammy Awards, including Best Rock Album five times, making them among the most successful rock acts in Grammy history. In 2021, the band was announced as recipients of the first "Global Icon" award at the 2021 MTV Video Music Awards, and they were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

Darthwhat's Foo Fighters table and accompanying video PuP pack for Visual Pinball X is a re-theme of Goldchicco's "Rush 2112" table.

481081.overview:
It's late. Danger can strike at any moment. In every corner of the city there is a catastrophe in the making. The air smells like hot ashes and gasoline as another pyromaniac lurks in the dark tonight... but the Flame Reaper Team is waiting, ready for the Blaze!

Flame Reaper 2010: First Responders Unit is an incredibly creative, enhanced tribute to an earlier table, Flame Reaper (Anthias, 2005). Released by talented developer Polygame in 2010, the game is transformed into a literal firefighting challenge, as flames begin as soon as you start the game, and if the flames get to the top of the building, then it's an instant game over. To make things more difficult, you can only fight the fire when the FIREFIGHTING Mode is ON.

To activate FIREFIGHTING Mode, players must drop the 5 Targets in the center of the table (FORCED ENTRY) to access the WaterPump SENSOR behind them. When done, you are granted 60 seconds to try to hit the WaterPump SENSOR repeatedly to extinguish the Fire. This SENSOR is linked to the MULTIPLIER TARGET so the higher the number, the faster the fire will go out.

The game is full of charm and polish, and is still widely regarded as one of the best Future Pinball tables ever made.

481188.overview:
Dare to return to Camp Crystal Lake, where the nightmare never truly ended! 

This pulse-pounding pinball game plunges you into the terror of Friday the 13th Part 2. The playfield is a chilling recreation of the camp, complete with dense forest artwork, cabin details, and the ominous silhouette of Jason Voorhees lurking in the shadows.

This is not just a pinball game - it's a descent into the heart of horror. Can you survive the night at Camo Crystal Lake?

Friday the 13th Part 2 is a re-theme of Pharaoh (Williams, 1981) for Visual Pinball X based on the 1981 sequel to Friday the 13th.
